# Native desktop dependency provenance

`sources.json` records exact revisions and SHA-256 hashes for the pristine vendored files.
Their original licenses are retained next to them. These are desktop implementation dependencies,
not a claim that the first iklib two-game curation proof is complete.

| Component | Use | Pin / license |
| --- | --- | --- |
| microui | Immediate-mode C controls and drawing commands | 2.02, commit `0850aba860959c3e75fb3e97120ca92957f9d057`; MIT |
| stb_truetype / stb_textedit / stb_image_write | Trusted local font rasterization, native text editing, and in-memory JPEG encoding of game-recording keyframes (spec 081) | Commit `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`; MIT or public domain |
| cJSON | Workspace JSON messages and persisted layout | 1.7.19; MIT |
| libvterm | Actual PTY terminal emulation | 0.3.3 official release archive; MIT |
| libcurl | Bounded local HTTP/WebSocket client transport | 8.22.0 archive SHA-256 in `orchestrator/native/curl.cmake`; curl license |
| SDL2 | Native window, input, clipboard and texture rendering | External development prerequisite, exact 2.32.10; zlib license |
| glad | Header-only OpenGL 3.3 core loader for the GPU adapter, loaded through `SDL_GL_GetProcAddress` | Generated by glad 2.0.8 with its bundled specification (command in `sources.json`); generated code (WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0, generator MIT |
| cmkr | Generates the committed `CMakeLists.txt` files from `cmake.toml` at configure time | `cmake/cmkr.cmake` clones tag `v0.2.46` of github.com/build-cpp/cmkr into the build directory and builds it on first configure; MIT |
| Corrosion | Imports the `red/` cargo workspace into the CMake build and drives cargo from it (charter D57, spec 128) | `cmake.toml` FetchContent clones commit `1499b14e4906a2890f5cee1547c8848db261753d` (tag `v0.6.1`) of github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion into the build directory at configure time; MIT. The toolchain itself is pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml` and installed through the owner's rustup, never silently |
| prost / prost-build | Generates the Rust types of the red.v1 wire contract from `red/red-core/proto` (charter D57, spec 128 decision 5) | `red/Cargo.lock` is the pin: it records the exact version and a SHA-256 for every crate in the tree, which is the guarantee `sources.json` gives the vendored C sources. Cargo fetches them from crates.io against those checksums; Apache-2.0 |
| protoc | Parses the `.proto` contract for prost-build | External development prerequisite like SDL2, checked for by `init.sh` and installed by the owner, never silently; BSD-3-Clause |
| Vulkan-Headers | Vulkan adapter API declarations; entry points load through SDL at runtime | Tag `v1.4.328`, core and vk_video headers, no platform headers; Apache-2.0 or MIT |
| Inter | Bundled UI face in Regular, Medium and SemiBold so weights are real faces and metrics match on both desktops | Release `v4.1`; OFL-1.1 |
| Phosphor Icons | Icon face rasterised through the same font path; card symbols map to it in `orchestrator/native/icons.json` | Tag `v2.1.2`, regular weight; MIT |

The normal CMake configure clones the pinned cmkr tag to regenerate the build files and fetches and
verifies libcurl's pinned archive on its first build.
It does not run a downloaded installer or access the network at application startup. libcurl is
built without TLS and non-HTTP protocols for the existing loopback-only desktop service; the C
client rejects non-loopback service addresses. Quest/web pairing needs its own reviewed secure
transport. Do not expose this local protocol as a remote service.

Owned C source stays under 1,000 lines per file. Vendored upstream sources remain intact, rather
than changing their layout or stripping their licenses/comments to meet an owned-code guideline.
